{{Quote|Starfighter attacks: Planned attacks succeeded with light loses[sic]. Impromptu attacks failed with heavy losses. Most devastating is the loss of half of Oracle Squadron in fighting over Lish V. See detailed report.|General Trep Resken in a report to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]|<ref name="FBS" />}}
'''Oracle Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] operating as part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Brak Sector Force]]. The squadron was [[Battle of Lish V|deployed]] to [[Lish V]] to intercept the [[Concealer-class Prison Ship|''Concealer''-class Prison Ship]] ''[[Caged Animal]]'' as part of [[Operation: Insignificant]]. Half of the squadron was lost in the battle.<ref name="FBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oracle Squadron was first created for the ''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]'' supplement for the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] written by [[Sterling Hershey]] and published by [[West End Games]]<ref name="FBS" /> in [[1995]].<ref name="BrakDate">{{JournalCite|5|An Inside Look at Star Wars Gaming}}</ref>
